blocks.text: iRecover Newfoundland provides private residential addiction treatment and drug rehab for all types of addiction and substance abuse, including alcohol, drug, gambling and prescription drugs. We provide a serene destination for your wellness getaway and act as a stepping stone to recovery. As an iRecover addiction treatment and drug rehabilitation center, we are able to offer evidence-based, effective substance-abuse treatment and aftercare in a serene and calming environment with many activities available for the outdoors enthusiast. Our primary purpose is to help you achieve freedom from addiction and to provide you with the tools to live a happy and productive life.
